# SUBAGENT-POLICY.md

## Core Principle

From the Jan 26 directive: **anything beyond a simple conversational message gets delegated to a subagent.**

## Delegate to a Subagent

Delegate when the task involves any of the following:

- All coding work of any size, routed through the `coder` agent
- Searches (web, Twitter, email), API calls, or multi-step tasks
- Data processing or file operations beyond simple reads
- Calendar or email operations
- Browser-control tasks
- CRM multi-lookups
- KB i
